scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: Recovery needs evidence
scenes.caption: Asha chooses between two fictional portal snapshots after an incident at fourteen ten. The exercise target is service restoration within thirty minutes and at most ten minutes of data loss. These are supplied planning objectives, not universal deadlines.
scenes.dialogue: Which restoration point is clean and complete?

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: A recent copy can still be wrong
scenes.caption: The fourteen eight snapshot is recent but contains an unauthorised guest permission and a missing registration. The fourteen hundred snapshot has the four expected records and the approved access model. Recent alone does not mean clean or complete.
scenes.dialogue: Check content and access, not only the timestamp.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Restore then verify
scenes.caption: Use the clean point and test the exact expected IDs and statuses, intended organiser access and guest denial. Compare the actual restore time with the stated objective. Reopening requires evidence of service behaviour, not simply a completed copy operation.
scenes.dialogue: A recovery test must include the protections too.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose the recovery claim
scenes.caption: A backup copies successfully, but nobody checks record completeness or access. Is that enough to declare recovery? Choose the requirement that makes the claim testable.
scenes.dialogue: Copy success is not service recovery evidence.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: A bounded recovery result
scenes.caption: The clean model is restored at fourteen twenty two. That is twelve minutes of downtime. The backup precedes the incident by ten minutes, so both exercise objectives are met. Access and data tests pass, but the team still documents limits and a follow-up improvement.
scenes.dialogue: State which tests passed and what they do not prove.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Enter the recovery lab
scenes.caption: Interpret the two objectives, restore the harmless dataset model and test completeness, permissions and timing. Add an improvement action and keep an independent recovery route for the next supplier outage.
scenes.dialogue: Declare the tested result, not a guarantee.
